headline: Paralegal
summary: Paralegal with five years in a law firm handling family, property and commercial cases in Rizal and Metro Manila. I draft pleadings, contracts and deeds, research laws and jurisprudence, review contracts for the partners and keep clients compliant with filing and registration rules. I manage heavy caseloads and court deadlines reliably.

certifications.name: Notarial Practice and Legal Forms Seminar

skills: Property law: titles, sales, estate settlement
Regulatory compliance for registrations and filings
Compliance with procedural rules and deadlines

experience.title: Paralegal
bullets: Support two partners on about 60 active family, property and commercial cases.
Draft pleadings, deeds of sale, extrajudicial settlements and lease contracts.
Research laws and decisions and prepare case memos for the partners.
Track court and registration deadlines and file documents with courts and registries.

experience.title: Legal Assistant
bullets: Prepared affidavits and notarial documents and kept the notarial register.
Organised case files and client records.

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in Legal Management
